message: What roles are on this website?
response:
**SevaConnect User Roles & Access Levels:**

1. **Donor (Portal: `/donor`):**
   • Can pledge money or relief items to active campaigns.
   • View donation timeline and audit history (`/donor/history`).
   • Download official 80G tax receipts for verified contributions.
   • Submit feedback and ratings on verified contributions.
   • Receive personalized campaign recommendations.

2. **Volunteer (Portal: `/volunteer`):**
   • Complete skill and availability profile (`/volunteer/profile`).
   • View assigned community relief delivery tasks.
   • Update task statuses ('In Progress', 'Delivered').
   • View total service hours, completed tasks, and impact summary (`/volunteer/history`).

3. **Administrator (Portal: `/admin`):**
   • Oversee campaigns, verify/reject donations, and manage users.
   • Review beneficiary assistance requests and allocate warehouse inventory.
   • Assign delivery tasks to registered volunteers.
   • Manage real-time inventory and monitor low-stock thresholds.
   • Access executive analytics, audit logs, and intelligent pattern insights.

message: How do I download my 80G tax receipt?
response:
**80G Tax Exemption Receipts on SevaConnect:**

• **Eligibility:** All verified monetary donations made to registered campaigns are eligible for 50% tax deduction under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act.
• **How to Download:**
  1. Log in to your account and go to **My Donations** (`/donor/history`).
  2. Find any donation marked with the **Verified** or **Completed** badge.
  3. Click **Download 80G Receipt** to obtain your official printable receipt.
• **Digital Validation:** Each receipt includes an embedded QR validation code linking to the real-time donation verification audit.

message: How does the centralized inventory work?
response:
**Centralized Inventory & Stock Tracking (`/admin/inventory`):**

• **Real-Time Warehouse Stock:** Tracks emergency relief items (e.g. *Family Ration Kits, Thermal Blankets, First-Aid Boxes, Hygiene Packs, Remedial Study Kits*).
• **Stock Quantities:** Displays available stock, distributed stock, and total inventory.
• **Low Stock Alerts:** Automatically warns administrators when available stock falls at or below the predefined minimum reorder threshold.
• **Manual Stock Adjustments:** Admins can record additions (new supplies) or deductions with reason codes and audit tracking.
• **Transaction History:** Full historical log of all additions, allocations, and manual adjustments.
